subject: reasoning
question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters V, H, A, N, B and J. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face N?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73cc65ae40162296d6cfd171e8981c5281ce62ca43b5089d9c2791470dcefd58.png]
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42c132a4c1bb23353158c29475de436f643a83ced9dfbb20fc753abb8d93bf87.png] 

As J is common in both dice.

Moving clockwise from the Common letter J,

Opposite pairs.

H ⇔ V

B ⇔ A

J ⇔ N

Thus, the opposite face of N is J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
